statement: let D := fun (q a n : ℕ) => (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=a%q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/(Nat.totient q:ℝ); let J := fun (q a l u : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => 2 * Real.pi * |β| * (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico l u, |D q a m|); let T : ℕ := 8000000000; ∀ (q a n : ℕ) (β : ℝ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 4000000000000000000 ≤ n → |β| ≤ 105/((q:ℝ)*n) → J q a 0 T β ≤ (n:ℝ)/10^12

plain_statement.en: New route · Skirts and explicit arithmetic inputs · SI-8004 · Bound the pre-threshold phase loss by n/10¹²

brief.zh: 对 m<T=8·10⁹ 用 Λ(k)≤log T，故 |D(m)|≤m(log T+1)。代入 C、半宽 105/(qn) 和整数端点，保留绝对常数。
brief.en: Below T=8·10⁹ use Λ(k)≤log T and |D(m)|≤m(log T+1). Insert the cutoff C and width 105/(qn), keeping the endpoints and constants.
